slug: 2024-06-12 Only 34 per cent of Mozambicans have an identity card
note: Gives IOM shares of adults holding an identity card (34%) and a birth certificate (55%) as of June 2024 and a French-funded IOM project issuing civil-registration documents to displaced people in Cabo Delgado; shares of people documented, with no information system named and nothing on how offices register.
